vo.en: I will read your mind now.

visual.description: A close-up shot of a man staring intensely and directly into the camera lens with a focused expression.

vo.en: Stay focused. Answer these out loud as fast as you can. What’s 2 plus 2? 4 plus 4? 8 plus 8? 16 plus 16?

visual.description: Fast-paced montage of digital numbers flashing on a screen and a ticking mechanical clock.

vo.en: Now, pick a number between twelve and five. Don't overthink it, just grab one!

visual.description: A man's hand reaching out and pointing toward the viewer as if selecting something in the air.

vo.en: Wait, this is the part where your brain starts to glitch.

visual.description: A high-energy digital glitch effect with distorted colors and static across the screen.

vo.en: Quick, name a common tool and a bright color. Got them? Keep them in your head.

visual.description: A top-down view of vibrant red paint being mixed and a blurred toolbox in the background.

vo.en: You are currently thinking of a Red Hammer. Over ninety percent of people choose exactly that.

visual.description: A clear, sharp shot of a hammer with a bright red handle resting on a wooden workbench.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's mind test and comment YES if this worked on you. This works because I will

visual.description: A man nodding knowingly at the camera while tapping his temple with one finger.
